paragraphs.en: Ponytail 5: rebuilt from the ground up. -53% code · -41% time · -26% cost · -45% tokens And yet: 98% of risky logic ships with a test. Without Ponytail: 68%. Benchmarked in Claude Code, the same agent with and without the skill: 39 tasks including a real FastAPI + React repo, Opus 5.5, 5 runs each. Details .
paragraphs.zh: Ponytail 5：从零重构。-53% 代码 · -41% 时间 · -26% 成本 · -45% token。然而：98% 的高风险逻辑都附带测试。没有 Ponytail 时：68%。 在 Claude Code 中进行基准测试，对比同一智能体启用与不启用该技能的表现：39 项任务，包括一个真实的 FastAPI + React 仓库，Opus 5.5，每项运行 5 次。详情见 。

paragraphs.en: You know him. Long ponytail. Oval glasses. Has been at the company longer than the version control. You show him fifty lines; he looks at them, says nothing, and replaces them with one.
paragraphs.zh: 你认识他。长长的马尾辫，椭圆形眼镜。 他在公司的年头比版本控制系统还长。 你给他看五十行代码；他看了一眼，什么也没说，然后用一行替换掉了。

paragraphs.en: Two things the chart does not show: in a blind comparison, Ponytail 5's replies beat the previous Ponytail's 110 to 67. And on the six security tasks (SQL injection, path traversal, forged tokens, rate limiting, malformed CSV rows, caching) it passed all 30 runs: less code, no less safe. Method, per-task tables and limits: benchmarks/results/2026-10-07-agentic.md .
paragraphs.zh: 图表没有展示两点：在盲测对比中，Ponytail 5 的回答以 110 比 67 胜过上一代 Ponytail。 在六项安全任务（SQL 注入、路径遍历、伪造令牌、速率限制、畸形 CSV 行、缓存）上，它通过了全部 30 次运行：代码更少，安全性丝毫不减。 方法、各任务表格及局限性见：benchmarks/results/2026-10-07-agentic.md。

paragraphs.en: The rule was never "fewest tokens." It is: write only what the task needs, and never cut validation, error handling, security, or accessibility. The code ends up small because it is necessary, not golfed. Lower cost and latency are a side effect.
paragraphs.zh: 规则从来不是“用最少的令牌”，而是：只写任务所需的内容，绝不删减验证、错误处理、安全性或无障碍支持。 代码最终很精简，是因为它确实需要这样，而不是刻意压缩。 更低的成本和延迟只是附带效果。

sents.zh: 更低的成本和延迟只是附带效果。

paragraphs.en: You ask for a date picker. Without Ponytail, the agent installs a date picker library or builds a whole calendar by hand: 335 lines. Ponytail 5 first looks at what is already there: the repo has an Input component, and every browser has a date picker. It puts the two together. 10 lines.
paragraphs.zh: 你需要一个日期选择器。 没有 Ponytail，智能体会安装一个日期选择器库，或者手工构建一整套日历：335 行代码。 Ponytail 5 首先会查看已有的内容：代码库里有一个 Input 组件，而且每个浏览器都自带日期选择器。 它把两者结合在一起。10 行代码。

sents.zh: 它把两者结合在一起。10 行代码。

paragraphs.en: /ponytail-review used to look only for code to cut. Now it reviews like the senior dev who gets paged when it breaks: it reads the code your change touches, not just the diff, and checks bugs, security, real load, missing tests, speed, and what to cut. Each finding says what the code does, what goes wrong, how to fix it, and what happens if you don't.
paragraphs.zh: /ponytail-review 过去只查找可以删减的代码。 现在它的审查方式就像那个系统一出问题就会被呼叫的资深开发者：它会阅读你的改动所涉及的代码，而不仅仅是 diff，并检查 bug、安全性、真实负载、缺失的测试、性能，以及哪些内容可以删减。 每一条发现都会说明代码做了什么、哪里会出问题、如何修复，以及不修复会有什么后果。

paragraphs.en: /ponytail-audit runs the same checks on the whole repo. It maps the code first: entry points, how data moves, what load the project expects. Then it ranks what it finds and tells you what to fix first. The old audit only listed what to delete.
paragraphs.zh: /ponytail-audit 会对整个代码库执行相同的检查。 它会先对代码进行映射：入口点、数据如何流动、项目预期承受的负载。 然后它会对发现的问题排序，并告诉你应优先修复什么。 旧的审计只会列出需要删除的内容。

paragraphs.en: In Claude Code, ponytail now shows a band above the prompt: what the current task costs, how many tokens and how much agent time it used, how often it reused existing code instead of writing new code, and whether the tests passed after the last change. Its buttons switch the level, run /ponytail-review or /ponytail-audit , copy the task as Markdown, and fold the band into one line. Don't want it? /ponytail band hides it, the same command brings it back. Needs Claude Code 2.1.290 or later, in the terminal or the desktop app. It does not show in the VS Code chat panel, cloud sessions or claude -p .
paragraphs.zh: 在 Claude Code 中，ponytail 现在会在提示符上方显示一个信息条：显示当前任务的花费、消耗了多少 token 和多少智能体时间、复用现有代码而非编写新代码的频率，以及最后一次修改后测试是否通过。 它的按钮可以切换级别、运行 /ponytail-review 或 /ponytail-audit、将任务复制为 Markdown，以及将信息条折叠为一行。 不想要它？/ponytail band 可以将其隐藏，再次运行同一命令即可恢复。 需要 Claude Code 2.1.290 或更高版本，在终端或桌面应用中均可使用。 它不会显示在 VS Code 聊天面板、云端会话或 claude -p 中。

paragraphs.en: Board opens a local page with every task across your projects: cost, agent time and tokens over time, every session with its tests, and the days you worked. By default, everything stays on your machine, in ~/.config/ponytail/band/ . /ponytail band import adds your past Claude Code sessions to it, with their cost, agent time and tokens.
paragraphs.zh: Board 会打开一个本地页面，汇总你所有项目中的每一项任务：成本、智能体时间与随时间变化的 token 用量，每个会话及其测试，以及你工作的日期。 默认情况下，所有内容都保存在你的电脑上的 ~/.config/ponytail/band/ 目录中。/ponytail band import 会把你过去的 Claude Code 会话（连同其成本、智能体时间和 token）添加进去。

paragraphs.en: The ladder runs after it understands the problem, not instead of it: it reads the code the change touches and traces the real flow before picking a rung. Lazy about the solution, never about reading.
paragraphs.zh: 这个阶梯（ladder）是在理解问题之后才使用，而不是替代理解：它会先阅读该改动涉及的代码并追踪真实的执行流程，然后再选择某个梯级。 在解决方案上可以偷懒，但在阅读上从不偷懒。

sents.en: The ladder runs after it understands the problem, not instead of it: it reads the code the change touches and traces the real flow before picking a rung.
sents.zh: 这个阶梯（ladder）是在理解问题之后才使用，而不是替代理解：它会先阅读该改动涉及的代码并追踪真实的执行流程，然后再选择某个梯级。

sents.en: Lazy about the solution, never about reading.
sents.zh: 在解决方案上可以偷懒，但在阅读上从不偷懒。

paragraphs.en: Lazy, not negligent: trust-boundary validation, data-loss handling, security, and accessibility are never on the chopping block.
paragraphs.zh: 懒惰而非疏忽：信任边界验证、数据丢失处理、安全性和可访问性永远不会被牺牲。

paragraphs.en: Logic with a branch, a loop, a parser, money or security leaves one small test behind. Every reply ends with what was skipped or not checked and any risk you should know.
paragraphs.zh: 带有分支、循环、解析器、资金或安全逻辑的代码，总会留下一个小小的测试盲区。 每次回复都会以说明跳过了什么或未检查什么，以及任何你应当知晓的风险作为结尾。

paragraphs.en: Ponytail is one prompt: skills/ponytail/SKILL.md . The compact version, for agents that read a rules file, is AGENTS.md . Everything else in this repo loads that prompt into different agents.
paragraphs.zh: Ponytail 是一个提示词：skills/ponytail/SKILL.md 。 精简版本是 AGENTS.md ，供读取规则文件的智能体使用。 本仓库中的其他所有内容都是将该提示词加载到不同的智能体中。

paragraphs.en: /plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail /plugin install ponytail@ponytail Codex:
paragraphs.zh: /plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail /plugin install ponytail@ponytail Codex：

paragraphs.en: codex plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail codex plugin add ponytail@ponytail Then open /hooks in Codex, trust its two lifecycle hooks, and start a new thread.
paragraphs.zh: codex plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail codex plugin add ponytail@ponytail 然后在 Codex 中打开 /hooks，信任其中的两个生命周期钩子，并开启一个新线程。

paragraphs.en: Any other agent: copy AGENTS.md into your project, or ask your agent to install skills/ponytail/SKILL.md as a skill. Step by step for Copilot, Cursor, OpenCode, Gemini and the rest: INSTALL.md .
paragraphs.zh: 其他任何智能体：将 AGENTS.md 复制到你的项目中，或者让你的智能体把 skills/ponytail/SKILL.md 作为一项技能安装。 针对 Copilot、Cursor、OpenCode、Gemini 及其他工具的分步说明：INSTALL.md 。

paragraphs.en: That was it. He'd be proud. He won't say it.
paragraphs.zh: 就是这样。他会感到骄傲的。他不会说出口。

paragraphs.en: Active every session, with a handful of commands (see Commands ). /ponytail ultra exists for when the codebase has wronged you personally. Startup and mode-change text shows the current mode.
paragraphs.zh: 每个会话都处于激活状态，只需少数几条命令（见 Commands）。/ponytail ultra 是为代码库 personally 冒犯了你的时候准备的。 启动和模式切换的文本会显示当前模式。

paragraphs.en: Commands need a skill-capable host (Claude Code, Codex, Devin CLI, OpenCode, Gemini, Antigravity CLI, pi, Hermes Agent, Qoder, Grok Build). In Codex CLI and the IDE extension they're skills under the plugin's namespace; invoke with $ponytail:ponytail-review . Cursor with the hooks gets /ponytail level switching only, typed as a plain message. The instruction-only adapters (Cursor's rule file, Windsurf, Cline, Copilot, Kiro, Antigravity's AGENTS.md fallback) load the always-on ruleset without the commands.
paragraphs.zh: 命令需要支持技能（skill）的宿主（Claude Code、Codex、Devin CLI、OpenCode、Gemini、Antigravity CLI、pi、Hermes Agent、Qoder、Grok Build）。 在 Codex CLI 及 IDE 扩展中，它们是插件命名空间下的技能（skill），通过 $ponytail:ponytail-review 调用。 带钩子（hooks）的 Cursor 只能通过纯文本消息获得 /ponytail 的级别切换。 仅指令类适配器（Cursor 的规则文件、Windsurf、Cline、Copilot、Kiro、Antigravity 的 AGENTS.md 回退方式）会加载常驻规则集，但不包含命令。

sents.en: The instruction-only adapters (Cursor's rule file, Windsurf, Cline, Copilot, Kiro, Antigravity's AGENTS.md fallback) load the always-on ruleset without the commands.
sents.zh: 仅指令类适配器（Cursor 的规则文件、Windsurf、Cline、Copilot、Kiro、Antigravity 的 AGENTS.md 回退方式）会加载常驻规则集，但不包含命令。

paragraphs.en: Does it need a config file? No. An optional ~/.config/ponytail/config.json or PONYTAIL_DEFAULT_MODE env var can set the default level, but nothing is required.
paragraphs.zh: 需要配置文件吗？不需要。 可选的 ~/.config/ponytail/config.json 或 PONYTAIL_DEFAULT_MODE 环境变量可以设置默认级别，但没有任何必需项。

paragraphs.en: Why does it write shortcut: comments? They mark a deliberate shortcut and when to revisit it, and /ponytail-debt collects them into a ledger. Want another word, or none? Say so in your project's CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md , then run /ponytail-debt <your word> .
paragraphs.zh: 为什么它会写下 shortcut: 注释？ 这些注释标记了一个有意为之的捷径以及何时回访它，而 /ponytail-debt 会把它们汇总成一份清单。 想换个词，还是不要这个词？ 在你项目的 CLAUDE.md 或 AGENTS.md 中说明，然后运行 /ponytail-debt <你的词> 。

paragraphs.en: What if I really need the 120-line cache class? You don't. Insist anyway and he'll build it. Slowly. Correctly. While looking at you.
paragraphs.zh: 如果我真的需要那个 120 行的缓存类呢？你不需要。 你要是坚持，他还是会把它做出来。慢慢做。正确地做。同时盯着你看。
